name: Paneer Tikka Sheet Pan
ingredients: 1 bell pepper, 1 onion and 1 cup cauliflower, chunked
1 tsp tikka masala and 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste
½ tsp chilli powder and ½ tsp ajwain
Juice of ½ lemon, salt, coriander
steps: Mix the yogurt, tikka masala, ginger-garlic paste, oil, spices, lemon and salt. Coat the paneer, chickpeas and vegetables and marinate for 20 minutes.
Heat the oven to 220°C. Spread everything on a lined tray.
Roast for 25 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges.
Finish with coriander and lemon and serve with raita or salad.
note: High protein from paneer and chickpeas on a single tray.
